an10.100:1.1: dasa ime bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ
an10.100:1.3: rāgaṃ dosaṃ mohaṃ kodhaṃ upanāhaṃ makkhaṃ palāsaṃ issaṃ macchariyaṃ mānaṃ.
an10.100:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave dasa dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
an10.100:2.1: dasayime bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ
an10.100:2.3: rāgaṃ dosaṃ mohaṃ kodhaṃ upanāhaṃ makkhaṃ palāsaṃ issaṃ macchariyaṃ mānaṃ.
an10.100:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave dasa dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātunti.
